release_notes: Major feature release with a new Koch receive practice mode, including guided progression, manual stages, full-character-set practice, Farnsworth-style effective WPM spacing, receive-copy scoring, session history and local Koch skill tracking.
Added generated radio-style background noise for Koch receive playback to make listening practice feel more alive while keeping the Morse tone clear.
Added radio channel noise to Morsewurst Network for a more authentic radio communication atmosphere. The noise is generated locally and includes configurable profile, tone and level controls.
Improved network receive playback with jitter-buffer handling, stale tone dropping and clearer feedback when incoming tones arrive too late.
Fixed a startup/shutdown race condition where the serial auto-connect background thread could try to call Tkinter after the main UI loop was no longer available.
Updated language files and user interface text across supported languages.
Improved settings persistence, database handling, stability and general user experience.
Includes many smaller bug fixes, regression test additions and internal cleanup improvements.
